Map Description Did you know regular eye tests can help detect eye conditions like cataracts and glaucoma? They can also help highlight health conditions like diabetes and high blood pressure. If a health problem is detected, you can discuss it further with your Optometrist or a trusted medical professional. At Bupa Optical and Hearing Brisbane we can check the health of your eyes, fit you in the latest fashion frames and our hearing partner Amplifon can also give you a comprehensive hearing assessment. Yes that's right, you can get a free hearing test too. Thinking about contact lenses? We can help you find out if they're right for you. We bulk bill eye tests for eligible Medicare card holders.
